### Alto Neuroscience Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 3, 2026


MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Alto Neuroscience, Inc. (“Alto”) (NYSE: ANRO), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel precision medicines for neuropsychiatric disorders, today announced that members of the Company’s management team will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference, November 10-12, 2026**


- Format: Fireside chat and one-on-one meetings
- Presentation Date & Time: Wednesday, November 11 at 8:00 AM ET
- Location: New York, New York


- **Jefferies London Healthcare Conference, November 16-19, 2026**


- Format: Fireside chat and one-on-one investor meetings
- Presentation Date & Time: Thursday, November 19 at 9:30 AM GMT
- Location: London, UK


The presentations will be accessible via a live webcast on the[Events and Presentations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.altoneuroscience.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54634013&newsitemid=20261103066561&lan=en-US&anchor=Events+and+Presentations&index=1&md5=b122d2dee3fbc49c2ac87833ac90829c) page in the Investors section of Alto’s website and a replay will be available following the presentation.


**About Alto Neuroscience**


Alto Neuroscience (NYSE: ANRO) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to transform the treatment of mental health conditions through a deeper understanding of the brain. Leveraging its proprietary Precision Psychiatry Platform™, Alto is advancing a broad pipeline of novel medicines for depression, schizophrenia, and other neuropsychiatric disorders. The Company’s lead program, ALTO-207, is in late-stage clinical development for treatment-resistant depression. For more information, visit[www.altoneuroscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.altoneuroscience.com&esheet=54634013&newsitemid=20261103066561&lan=en-US&anchor=www.altoneuroscience.com&index=2&md5=5fd019240cd9e353deec85350e6884ea) or follow Alto on[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FAltoNeuro&esheet=54634013&newsitemid=20261103066561&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=3&md5=6cf3ca49e26119325c91ecce4c99b6ba) .


**Availability of Information on Alto’s Website**


Alto routinely uses its investor relations website to post presentations to investors and other important information, including information that may be material. Accordingly, Alto encourages investors and others interested in Alto to review the information it makes public on its investor relations website.
